annotations.exact_quote: Subspace clustering refers to the problem of segmenting data drawn from a union of subspaces.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确将子空间聚类定义为对来自子空间并集的数据进行分割，并将其作为论文研究任务。

annotations.exact_quote: expressing each data point as a structured sparse linear combination of all other data points
annotations.reason_zh: 所提S3C将每个样本表示为其他样本的稀疏线性组合，符合稀疏表示以少量基/字典原子表达样本的定义。

annotations.exact_quote: we propose a joint optimization framework - Structured Sparse Subspace Clustering (S3C) - for learning both the affinity and the segmentation.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文提出联合优化框架来学习亲和矩阵与分割，属于学习或修正样本间亲和/邻接结构的图结构学习。

annotations.exact_quote: we extend the proposed S3C framework into Constrained S3C (CS3C) in which available partial side-information is incorporated into the stage of learning the affinity.
annotations.reason_zh: CS3C将可用的部分侧信息作为有限监督融入亲和学习，与未标注/无监督主体结合，符合半监督学习设定。

annotations.exact_quote: available partial side-information is incorporated into the stage of learning the affinity
annotations.reason_zh: 约束扩展明确将部分侧信息用于亲和学习，不完整监督是其学习条件，符合弱监督设定。

abstentions.reason_zh: 摘要仅称“partial side-information”被融入亲和学习，未说明其为must-link/cannot-link成对约束，也未说明进行约束传播，无法确认满足成对约束传播定义。
